scope: Entire portfolio metadata/indexing plus homepage and four case-study social previews and mobile performance.
findingsAndFixes: Added self-canonical and Open Graph URLs for all indexable pages.
Centralised full Open Graph and Twitter metadata so nested pages do not drop descriptions/images or inherit homepage Twitter copy.
Added statically generated 1200 × 630 PNG previews for all four case studies with visible release status and image alternative text.
Sitemap uses maintained project/article dates and omits dates for static pages without a maintained timestamp instead of setting every date to each build time.
Converted large hero and supporting photo assets to WebP; retained originals and evidence screenshots.
Preload the existing Latin variable font through next/font/local with font-metric fallback adjustment; preload hero images with high priority; keep screenshots lazy-loaded.
Added one-hour browser caching with stale-while-revalidate for mutable image and social-card paths.
Added CI export checks across all 32 indexable pages and runtime checks for crawler metadata, preview dimensions/types, redirects, 404 noindex, image budgets and cache headers.

performanceMethod.tool: Lighthouse 13.5.0 via official npm package and installed Playwright Chromium
performanceMethod.target: Local production static build served through wrangler dev on localhost:8787
performanceMethod.configuration: Default mobile emulation and simulated throttling; performance and SEO categories; sequential cold-browser runs without concurrent browser tests.
performanceMethod.limitations: Single lab samples, not production field data or guaranteed results. Scores vary with local scheduling and simulation. Baseline Lighthouse SEO already scored 100 despite missing canonical/social details, so the export and crawler checks cover gaps beyond the Lighthouse score.

intermediateHome.note: Image-only pass before the final critical font/hero-loading changes; this exposed the remaining render dependency.

validation.exportChecks: All 32 indexable pages passed the metadata, preview PNG and structured-data checks.
validation.visualChecks: Reviewed all four rendered social cards.
validation.browserTests: 104 passed, including metadata, social-image, HTTP/cache, image-loading, mobile layout and automated accessibility regressions on the final build.
validation.build: Static production build and lint passed; metadata check is part of build:ci.
